chose: The cast comes in through the template's shape (`cast: "cast-v1"`), as the brand's motion and theme do, so a version already pinned keeps the flat icons and a published essay's version never redraws. The Rust essay's version 6 and the interview essay's version 3 name it; each draws everything the version before it does. Rust Rounds writes version 6 where it wrote 5 (an essay with an opening), and the interview week writes 3 where it wrote 2; an essay with no opening stays at the lowest version that draws it (C270), and so keeps the flat icons.
options: an opt-in shape field, new versions only (chosen)
draw the cast in every version: simpler, but an essay already published would redraw differently from what was released
always write the newest version: gives every essay the cast, but breaks C270, so a stage built before would refuse an essay it could draw
gray: Which essays show the characters is something the owner sees; no check settled it. The cost: an essay with no opening keeps the flat icons until its producer writes a cast version.
undo: Drop `cast` from the essay versions' shapes and the schema, delete `rust-essay/v6.json`, and set ESSAY_VERSION back to 5 and INTERVIEW_ESSAY_VERSION to 2; essays written at 6 or 3 are then refused (VS1).
